app.name: juwri Desktop
setup.title: Connect to your store
setup.intro: Enter the address you use to sign in to juwri. The desktop app wraps that site and adds LAN printing.
setup.invalidUrl: That does not look like a web address.
settings.title: Desktop settings
bridge.title: Print bridge
bridge.port_in_use: Port 8543 is already in use — printing is off
bridge.port_in_use_help: Another program (or a second copy of this app) holds port 8543. The port is fixed by the print contract, so close the other program and restart this app.
bridge.listen_failed: The print bridge could not start
pairing.title: Pairing token
pairing.help: Open your dashboard → Settings → Printing, generate the desktop pairing token, and paste it here. It is what lets the till's browser reach this app's printers.
pairing.unpaired: Not paired — the dashboard will say “pair the desktop app”
pairing.encrypted: Stored encrypted by your operating system's keychain.
pairing.plaintext: Stored in a local settings file — this machine has no keychain available.
pairing.originsHelp: Only these sites may print. The address you connected to is always allowed; add another line for a custom domain.
printers.title: Printers
printers.none: No printers yet. Add the IP address of your kitchen or receipt printer.
printers.label: Name
printers.targetHelp: tcp://192.168.1.50:9100 for a network printer, or usb://0x04b8/0x0e15 for USB.
printers.invalid: That address is not a tcp:// or usb:// target.
printers.suggested: The website asked for these printers, which are not configured here:
shell.title: Application
shell.autoLaunch: Open automatically when this computer starts
error.unpaired: This desktop app is not paired yet.
error.unknown_target: That printer is not configured in this app.
error.econnrefused: The printer refused the connection — check that it is on and on this network.
error.etimedout: The printer did not answer in time.
error.payload_too_large: The ticket was too large to print.
error.internal: The bridge could not print this ticket.
error.usb_driver_unavailable: USB support is not installed in this build.
